node_types.name: requirement
node_types.comment: Project-level requirement. module.schema.json's copy carries preq_id in place of priority and derivation, since a module requirement derives by construction through its required preq_id. IDs are 12-char hex identity hashes computed by schema.IdentityHash.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Requirement priority (0-4). Optional; enforced by validator when present.

fields.name: derivation
fields.description: Declares a requirement not yet derived into any module. Project-scoped only: a module requirement derives by construction through its required preq_id.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: Identity hashes of other requirements this one depends on (depends_on edge).

fields.name: preq_id
fields.description: Identity hash of the project requirement this module requirement derives from.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: Identity hashes of other requirements this one depends on (depends_on edge).

fields.name: implements
fields.description: Requirement identity hashes this component implements (implements edge).

fields.name: uses
fields.description: Identity hashes of other components this one depends on (uses edge).

fields.name: uses
fields.description: Component identity hashes involved in this data flow (uses edge).

fields.name: describes
fields.description: Component identity hashes described by this test section (describes edge).

fields.name: provided_by
fields.description: Identity hashes of components in this module that provide this entry point (module-local).

fields.name: group
fields.description: Freeform grouping label for renderers (e.g. "cli", "http"). Spex never branches on it.
